title: KHR_animation_layers Animation Reference
description: A reference to an animation within a layer.

weight.description: Animation weight within this layer. Must not be NaN or Infinity.

typeOverride.description: Override the animation's intrinsic blend type. If omitted, uses the animation's KHR_animation_type.type or defaults to 'override'.

anyOf.description: Animation values fully replace the base pose.
Animation values represent deltas applied on top of the base pose.
